title: The Capital of Moon's Dark Side Rises to 14.37 Million, with Frequent Additional Investments Within the Year

content_html:
Recently, Beijing Moonshot Technology Co., Ltd., a leading company in large model technology in China, has undergone another major business change. Its registered capital has been officially increased from about 11.5753 million RMB to approximately 14.3723 million RMB, representing an increase of about 24%. Notably, this is not the first adjustment for the company this year. Looking back at its development throughout the year, the company's registered capital has experienced multiple intensive increases, rising from an initial 1 million RMB to approximately 14.3723 million RMB now.

As a highly anticipated AI unicorn company in China, Moonshot has been favored by the capital market since its official establishment in April 2023. Currently, the legal representative of the company is Yang Zhilin, and its core business scope covers software development and artificial intelligence-related software development in cutting-edge fields. In terms of equity structure, the company is mainly co-held by Yang Zhilin, Shenzhen Heshan Growth III Science and Technology Development Equity Investment Fund (Limited Partnership), and Zhou Xinyu, among others.

Considering previous market rumors about capital movements, as the company's valuation continues to expand and the need for rapid business growth, Moonshot has maintained a high level of activity in financing and capital operations. The continuous increase in registered capital not only further strengthens the company's capital strength but also lays a solid foundation for its subsequent continued investment in large model infrastructure R&D, product iteration, and further capital market strategies.
